digest.component_or_area: plan-review Pass-1 container criteria and sibling roster
propositions: Plan review certifies epics whose acceptance criteria are mutually unsatisfiable because no Pass-1 criterion checks joint satisfiability of a ticket's own ACs and Scope/Out-of-Scope declarations.

A new 1-TURN advisory coherence criterion 'ac-satisfiability' at 0.95 default is added to detect within-ticket set-quantification contradictions (universal-vs-carve-out, derived-artifact closure, snapshot cardinality).

G3's child-coverage audit can never fire because the sibling roster it receives carries only ids and titles, so the anti-false-positive rule silences it; the roster must include each child's acceptance-criteria items.

The sibling-roster-building expression is duplicated across three non-test callers (pass1.py, fidelity_spot_eval.py, eval_solver.py), so it is single-sourced into a shared build_sibling_roster helper to prevent divergence that would corrupt dogfooding data.

The roster is moved into the byte-stable system prompt prefix (sent once) instead of per-pairing instructions, and its token cost is added to the parent_tokens estimate feeding bin-packing and the warm-cache gate.
No changes are made under review_kernel since Pass-2's internal_conflict axis already grades this defect, and G3's posture and threshold are left unchanged pending dogfooding data.
